name: Review an agent's proposal like a pull request
description: The plugin's propose skill has the agent write the change as prose in .lastro/proposals/<slug>.md, run lastro plan (answering handoffs itself), show the user the review the plugin renders as Markdown (after each lastro command while the review is open the PostToolUse hook adds it to the agent's context, and lastro-plugin.mjs review prints it): a summary line, then each open decision with its numbered options and the recommended one, then the intents grouped by kind (Behavior, Never, Keeps working, Non-functional), one list item per intent with its id, statement, status (to review, approved, rejected, or approvals out of the policy's count) and the quote it came from; then ask the user every open decision and, per intent, approve, request changes (amend) or reject, recording only the user's answers with lastro review --as <user>, until lastro status is ready; then lastro spec derives the proofs into the repository's .lastro/. The PreToolUse hook makes every lastro review command that approves, answers, amends or rejects show a Claude Code permission prompt, and denies it in both harnesses when --as names an agent (claude, codex, agent, assistant, ai, bot). With a policy above one approval the board shows each intent's approvals out of the required number and the proposal waits for the other reviewers.
